description: Average farmland values in dollars per acre by state, from the USDA NASS annual Land Values survey — each row is one state, year, and land category (farm_real_estate for the headline farm-real-estate value including buildings, cropland, or pasture) with its per-acre value (USD/acre). Use for what farmland is worth; use get_cash_rents instead for what it costs to rent, and list_coverage to confirm which states and years are stored before querying. Read-only lookup of stored survey data; no API key. The survey is annual and the stored copy refreshes once a year after the August NASS release — the latest stored year is 2026. `state` takes a two-letter code (case-insensitive) and `year` a single survey year; land values are state-level, so county fields are empty and a `county` filter normally matches nothing. Returns up to `limit` rows (default 1000), newest year first; a filter combination with no stored rows returns a no-data result rather than an empty list.

county.description: County name as stored (uppercase, e.g. 'HANCOCK'). Accepted for parity with the REST endpoint and get_cash_rents, but land values are state-level rows with no county, so this normally matches nothing

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. 'IA' (case-insensitive; stored uppercase)

year.description: Survey year as an integer, e.g. 2026 (currently the only stored year — see list_coverage)

name: get_land_values
